components/operator/OperatorFields.tsx.reason: Every control here is rendered as the children of FieldFrame, which wraps them in a real <label> carrying the field's name. The survey reads one file at a time and cannot see a wrapper supplied by an enclosing component, so these six are named at render and unnamed only in the source. Adding a seventh field type changes the count and reopens all six, which is the point: the excuse is for this shape, not for this file.

components/ui/input.tsx.reason: The pass-through primitive itself, which forwards every prop and has no name of its own by construction. Its callers are the ones that owe a label, and the survey checks each of them where they render it.

app/globals.css.reason: Two decorative marks, neither of which carries information a reader needs: `.launch-hero::after` stamps 'DCLUTCH / DEVNET / 2026' sideways in the corner of the launch hero at 8px, and `.chart-watermark` is a watermark by name and by function. WCAG 1.4.3 exempts incidental and decorative text, and raising either to 4.5:1 would turn a texture into a competing label. Every other rule in this file that paints small text on a background this survey can resolve is above the floor; a third failure here changes the count and reopens both.
